written_before: the dev2 result is known and before any OpenOOD test image is read by this project
run_condition: only if the dev2 primary endpoint (prereg_confirm.json) passes; run exactly once
benchmark: OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K: ID test_imagenet (45,000); near = SSB-hard, NINCO; far = iNaturalist, Textures, OpenImage-O

method.tins: S_final from Codex's reproduction of unchanged upstream TINS (194759d), 1000 ID classes, stream seed 123, per-dataset ID+OOD streams (scores_openood_*.npz)
method.visual_view: d(x) with DINOv2 ViT-B/14 CLS features (standard eval preprocessing), m = 2, K(x) = CLIP ViT-B/16 zero-shot top-5 over the 1000 labels with the TINS template, support = first 12 of TINS's 16 shots per class, LOO med/MAD shrunk with n0 = 12
method.p_value: p_d(x) = (1 + #{calib d >= d(x)}) / (n_calib + 1), calib = last 4 of the 16 shots per class (4,000 images)

report: AUROC and FPR95 (Codex's convention, ties included) per dataset and near/far means for TINS, d only and fused; no other variant is evaluated on the test
